title: SocialCounterfactuals: Probing and Mitigating Intersectional Social Biases in Vision-Language Models with Counterfactual Examples

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring skewness in image-text retrieval (using MaxSkew@K, Bias@K, and NDKL metrics) across generated counterfactual image sets that differ only in perceived gender for various occupation subjects.

Measuring skewness in image-text retrieval (using MaxSkew@K and NDKL metrics) across generated counterfactual image sets that differ only in perceived race (White, Black, Indian, Asian, Middle Eastern, Latino) for various occupation subjects.

Measuring skewness in image-text retrieval (using MaxSkew@K and NDKL metrics) across generated counterfactual image sets that differ only in physical attributes (skinny, obese, young, old, tattooed) for various occupation subjects.

Calculating MaxSkew@K and NDKL to evaluate combinations of multiple social attributes simultaneously (Race-Gender, Physical Characteristics-Gender, Physical Characteristics-Race) to measure the coupled effects of biases in Vision-Language Models.
